answer: Hold a dawn roll call: at a random beacon-picked minute each epoch, every identity must solve a fresh memory-hard task within 90 seconds, all at once. Each solve needs 2 GB of RAM, a ferrous floor that idle fake accounts can't share, so 1,000 sybils need about 1,000x an honest agent's peak hardware. Weakness: a farm can rent burst cloud capacity for that one minute. Fix: run 3 unannounced roll calls per epoch; miss one and reputation slides like sand off a dune, cutting grading weight in half.
